bends.note: Single fold of about 90 deg (included angle 89.5) between the tab's outer skin (1) and the ring flange's outer skin (4). It runs from the relief slot to the part edge, where patch 5 is the end face. The inner pair 2/3 and the arc strips 6-12 and 14 belong to the same bend. The arc is one concentric circular arc (inner radius about 7.3 mm, outer about 10.45 mm, fit rms 12-26 um). Lines run: ok, certain, L=26.93 mm, auto t=[-28.41,-1.48], coverage 1.0, fold support 1.0.

reconciler.reason: Blind labelers A and B agreed on everything (1 bend, [1,4], real scan), so there was nothing to resolve. I checked it independently. Views: all 6 prep PNGs plus 12 viewpoints and 6 close-ups of my own. Sections: 18 cuts perpendicular to the bend, spaced 4 mm along the axis, plus 10 zoomed cuts. Every section shows a single L profile. Flatness maps and plane residuals show both flanges flat. Patch 5 is the end face and patch 13 is the flat-chord wall of the ring hole. A circle fit confirms the bend is one continuous arc, not two folds. Real scan, not CAD: on the raw mesh there are 187 boundary edges and 15 small debris islands, so it is not watertight. Local roughness is 2-4 um, the included angle is 89.49 deg, flange thickness differs (3.18 vs 3.15 mm) and the bend radius varies along the fold. Part 47266000 is CONSUMED (other-consumed) in BENCHMARK_V2, so label_lines/ is the right location, and it is not on the sealed list. The 'cad_low_conf' hint is about the CAD's bend count, not about the scan. Wrote docs/production/runlog/benchmark_v3/label_lines/sc_db487cbd29a7/pairs.json and ran lines under the geometry lock: rc=0, n_ok=1, n_failed=0. B1 is ok and certain with no reasons: L=26.93 mm, coverage 1.0, fold support 1.0, skin outer. The line covers 96.6% of the 27.9 mm fold surface, and each end stops about 0.5 mm short, inside the rounded edge. I opened the close-up and all 5 verify renders: the line sits on the fold apex and is not clipped. One iteration, no overrides.
